[LUNI.3.1.3] **Percent vs modulo.** `%` is always the modulo operator
([LGRA.9.2.1]) and never a unit symbol: it is not a `UNIT_SUFFIX` character
([LUNI.3.2]). A percentage is written with the `percent` unit or its alias
`pct`: `50_percent` and `50_pct` are `0.5`. `%` is that unit's `label`, which
is display only and gives no way to write the unit ([LUNI.5.2.1]).

So `50%` alone is a dangling-modulo syntax error, and the lexer refuses
`50_%`, whose `_` no unit suffix follows ([LLEX.11.1]), both as `DS_PARSE_GENERIC`.
